source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Air Injection Reactor System, p.6T-3

procedures.title: A.I.R. pump pulley: replace
steps: Keep the pulley from turning by squeezing the belt, and loosen the pulley bolts.
Remove the belt, then the pulley.
Fit the pulley with its bolts hand tight.
Holding the pulley by squeezing the belt, torque the pulley bolts to 25 ft. lbs.
Recheck belt tension and adjust if needed.
notes: Figure 4 in the manual shows air manifold, hose and tube routing.

procedures.title: A.I.R. pump filter: replace
steps: Remove the drive belt and pump pulley.
Pry off the outer disc of the filter fan.
Pull the rest of the filter off with pliers (see figure 6 in the manual), keeping fragments out of the air intake hole.
Draw the new filter on using the pulley and its bolts (see figure 7 in the manual); never hammer or press it on.
Tighten the bolts alternately so the filter goes down evenly, and make sure its outer edge slips into the housing; slight interference with the housing bore is normal.
